    S = 2048
    W = world_size

    # Precompute bidiagonal coefficients
    b = [0.2 + 0.12*(r % 4) for r in range(W)]
    
    # Combine stages to do more local work between collectives

    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
